needles: During the interception of hostile communications, we captured a data packet containing the identifier sequence 42455441313937. This appears to be a hex-encoded asset tag following the same pattern we observed in the Phoenix Protocol transmissions last month.

Analysis of previous communications confirms the encoding converts each character to its ASCII hex equivalent. The asset ID 42455441313937 requires immediate decoding to identify the compromised system before the next maintenance window expires.
